outcome: IQ at 7 years (Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of children born from singleton live births to women participating in the US National Collaborative Perinatal Project (1959-76).
finding: Placental abruption was associated with an increased risk of abnormal motor and mental assessments at 8 months, with these associations attenuating by 4 years and resolving by 7 years, largely mediated through preterm delivery.
